# Clinaza — Company, Pricing and Financing Facts

Updated: 24 November 2026. Public source: https://www.clinaza.in/about

## What is Clinaza?

Clinaza is a healthcare payment and financing technology platform operated by Mellowprints, a sole proprietorship in India. Clinaza also provides core clinic tools such as patient records, digital prescriptions and follow-up workflows. Clinaza facilitates technology and does not lend from its own balance sheet. The relevant regulated bank or NBFC determines credit approval, sanctioned amount, borrower terms and repayments.

## Is patient financing live?

No. Clinaza is currently onboarding clinics. No clinics are live for patient financing yet. Patient checkout becomes available only after clinic verification, partner underwriting and payment activation. Treatment pages describe potential payment options and illustrative calculations, not an available loan offer. Clinaza has no live patient financing outcome data or verified clinic conversion statistics to publish yet.

## What does clinic activation cost?

Clinics pay ₹999 one-time digital financing desk activation and merchant underwriting. This covers clinic verification, doctor KYC underwriting and Pine Labs lending gateway integration. There are ₹0 annual maintenance charges (AMC) and ₹0 monthly subscription fees. Free core CRM access is separate from financing activation. Transaction charges and patient lender charges are separate from the activation fee.

## Who provides payment and lending services?

Plural by Pine Labs supplies the gateway rails under Clinaza's institutional agreement. Clinaza is onboarding clinics for activation. Credit Card EMI depends on eligible cards, issuer terms and available limits. Debit Card EMI requires a qualifying pre-approved bank offer. Cardless financing depends on the relevant lender's availability and assessment. A payment network's supported banks do not mean every lender or payment option is available at every clinic or to every patient.

## What are patient rates and repayment terms?

The lender determines interest, APR, fees, loan amount, repayment schedule and tenure. Patients must review the lender's Key Facts Statement (KFS) and approved terms before accepting a loan. An illustrative EMI calculation or eligibility check is not a sanction or guaranteed approval. No universal patient interest rate or approval time is currently offered by Clinaza.

## How much will a clinic receive after activation?

The standard financed-loan platform MDR is 3.00%. In patient-borne mode, the clinic receives the treatment invoice less applicable MDR and agreed charges. Illustrative example only: a ₹60,000 invoice less ₹1,800 MDR at 3% gives ₹58,200 before any other agreed charges. If the clinic sponsors subvention, that agreed amount also reduces its settlement. This example is not a completed patient transaction.

The agreed settlement schedule is T+1 business day after successful processing and underwriting activation. The lender handles patient loan collections and the clinic has no patient credit-default recourse. Treatment delivery, refunds and chargebacks remain subject to the clinic agreement. Other payment methods have their own agreed processing charges; UPI processing is not universally free.

## Is there any hardware or shipping?

The financing desk is digital: payment links, dashboard checkout and on-screen QR codes. Bank account verification uses cancelled cheque upload, doctor PAN and underwriting review. No physical payment terminal or delivery is required.
